# Storyboard Studio

> Local-first narrative review for editable decision decks.

Storyboard Studio turns an author-supplied decision brief into an inspectable,
diffable story, diagnoses narrative weaknesses deterministically, and exports a
native editable PowerPoint plus a hash-verifiable Narrative Receipt. The no-key
workflow runs locally. Optional providers are explicit per draft.

## Primary links

- Product showcase: https://othmaneblial.github.io/Storyboard-Studio/
- Focused documentation: https://othmaneblial.github.io/Storyboard-Studio/docs.html
- Source and README: https://github.com/OthmaneBlial/Storyboard-Studio
- Latest stable release: https://github.com/OthmaneBlial/Storyboard-Studio/releases/latest
- Security policy: https://github.com/OthmaneBlial/Storyboard-Studio/security/policy
- Export compatibility: https://github.com/OthmaneBlial/Storyboard-Studio/blob/main/docs/EXPORT_COMPATIBILITY.md

## Important boundaries

- A Narrative Receipt verifies hashes and internal references, not factual truth.
- The public showcase is a product tour, not a hosted editor.
- The package is not published on PyPI yet; use the verified repository setup.
- Public user-research counts remain zero until consented external sessions occur.
- Gemini and loopback model adapters are optional; the deterministic compiler,
  Doctor, renderer, and receipt verification do not require a remote provider.
